peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 15.4% above its local comparables; 120 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (98.3): 9.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 398 of 405 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 50% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $3,129,000 ($2,701 psf, 1,130–1,334 sq ft; 10 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,341 psf (range $1,971–2,977); 15.4% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $417,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Great World MRT about 480 m, Havelock MRT about 500 m; closer than 216 of 551 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 340 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 440 m), more than 344 of 551 similar developments (the same as 74); nearest hawker centre Kukoh 21 Food Centre about 480 m; nearest park Pearl's Hill City Park about 650 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 270 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 370 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 380 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 400 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 520 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 550 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 610 m; Union Square Residences, 106 new sales, about 760 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 311 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,451 new sales and 1,116 resales (2,567 purchases); new sales were 56.5% of these purchases. Subsales (41) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,530 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,116 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 360 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,116 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,347 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−17.1%). Planning-area private resales −3.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
